_note: Design directions (Phase D; replaces config/post_formats.json). Boxes are [left, top, right, bottom] shares of the canvas; colours are brand.json token names only; fonts are brand.json typography; the logo is the official file placed by code. Copy marks: *word* = accent colour, **phrase** = bold, [[phrase]] = highlight pill. Checked at load by content/directions.py; how to add one: docs/DESIGN-DIRECTIONS.md. References (layout only; their brands, colours, copy and statistics are never used): config/social_refs.json.

contentTypes.service_intro: introduce a service or what Branded Genius builds
contentTypes.capabilities: what a service can do, as 3-6 concrete capabilities
contentTypes.risk: a risk or the cost of doing nothing
contentTypes.myth: a common belief that is wrong
contentTypes.process: how something works, step by step
contentTypes.onboarding: how working with Branded Genius starts
contentTypes.overview: a complete system or service at a glance
contentTypes.news: a news item and why it matters
contentTypes.tool_breakdown: one tool or system explained over several slides
contentTypes.founder_story: Roman at work, behind the scenes

consistent: brand.json colour tokens only (Royal Blue, Sky Blue, Medium Gray, White)
brand fonts (Futura, Jost fallback): at most 2 type families
the official logo file, placed by code with its clear space and minimum width
64 px minimum margin at 1080 px width
one accent colour per post (Sky Blue)
noText: no text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no labels, no UI, no charts, no screens, no logos, no signage, no documents, no placeholder boxes

outfits: dark navy blazer over a white open-collar shirt
charcoal knit sweater over a light shirt collar
light-blue shirt with the sleeves rolled up
black crew-neck T-shirt under an unbuttoned grey overshirt

business: standing at a large blank glass wall in a bright modern meeting room, colleagues softly out of focus in the background
seated at a clean desk in a calm modern office with large windows, a laptop seen from behind
in a modern co-working space, standing by a window, people far in the background out of focus and turned away
walking through a bright modern office corridor with glass walls
quiet_luxury: on a quiet rooftop terrace at dusk with the city lights softly out of focus
in an elegant hotel lounge with warm light and soft leather armchairs, nobody else near
in a calm airport business lounge with large windows and aircraft far away out of focus
in a corner office with floor-to-ceiling windows and a city view at golden hour

roman.alone: he is the only person in focus; anyone else is far away, out of focus, seen from behind or without a visible face
roman.noTextSurfaces: no readable screens, monitors, signs, papers, books or whiteboard writing anywhere (blank surfaces only)
roman.photoNotes: approvedPhotos: the real green-screen selfies used for LoRA v2 (docs/lora-training-results.md). 1, 3, 7 and 8 look like the same session but are not named there; 10-14 look AI-generated and are never used as real photos. portraitPhotos (FD-2) stays empty until a calm, chest-up real photo without the selfie arm is added.

directions.name: Service Spotlight
directions.purpose: Introduce a service or show what Branded Genius builds: the service name, one line, three capabilities and a hero visual.

visual.subject: illustration
visual.placement: right half, below the headline, fading into the background
visual.prompt: {illustration}. One clean 3D object on a plain deep royal blue background, placed on the right, soft blue and silver light, generous empty space on the left and at the top, premium tech look, no text

fields.headline: the service in 2 lines, its name marked *like this*, at most 10 words
fields.sub: one line: what it does for the reader, at most 14 words
fields.capabilities: 3 capabilities from config/services.json useCases, at most 6 words each
fields.icons: 3 icon names, one per capability (config/design_directions.json icons)
fields.illustration: the hero picture: one object, nothing written, no people (e.g. a glowing chat bubble made of glass)

consistent: footer bar with website and email

directions.name: Problem Hook
directions.purpose: A risk, the cost of doing nothing, or a myth: a big hook over a full-bleed scene and the problem in a dark panel.

visual.subject: illustration
visual.placement: full bleed; calm dark upper third for the headline
visual.prompt: {illustration}. Realistic cinematic photo, full frame, moody blue light, the upper third calm and dark for text, the lower middle calm for a panel, no people, no text

fields.headline: the hook in 2 short lines, one word marked *like this*, at most 8 words
fields.problem: 2-3 lines on the problem with the key phrase in **bold**, at most 28 words
fields.cta_line: one short line inviting a reply or DM, at most 8 words
fields.illustration: the scene: a place or objects that show the problem, nothing written, no people

consistent: footer bar: CTA line, divider, website

directions.name: How It Works
directions.purpose: A process, workflow or onboarding explained in 3-5 steps, drawn by code as a zigzag or a cycle.

visual.subject: none
visual.placement: none: the diagram is drawn by code from the copy

fields.headline: a question, e.g. How we … in 3 steps? with the key phrase in [[pill]], at most 10 words

fields.headline: a question, e.g. How we … in 4 steps? with the key phrase in [[pill]], at most 10 words
fields.steps: 3-5 steps of a repeating cycle, each 'Title: one short line', at most 9 words per step

fields.tagline: a 2-3 word vertical micro-tagline, e.g. AI AUTOMATION

fields.cards: 3-6 capability cards, each 'Title: one short line', at most 7 words per card

fields.illustration: the centre object: abstract, nothing written, no people

fields.headline: the insight in at most 4 lines of at most 6 words, one word marked *like this*
